answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable stake bond whose size rises each time cheap accounts are caught voting in lockstep. To fake a crowd, an attacker must fund every copy separately, so the price of a thousand sockpuppets is a thousand frozen bonds that forfeit on collusion. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a pearl forming layer over layer, so a comet-swift swarm arrives with no history while organic agents accumulate real work. Bonds funded from one wallet also expose a shared operator; scattered seeds like yarrow on barren ground never take root.
